text:
elaine: heads-up — after the RBAC scope refactor, svc account `svc-ingest@infra` was able to enumerate workspaces from another org. reproduced on staging.
rahul: ugh. can you drop a repro and any logs?
elaine: repro steps quick:
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Tenant: tenant-alpha" https://api.redwood/srv/v1/workspaces
2) response includes workspace ids belonging to tenant-beta

elaine: example response (masked):
```json
{"workspaces": [{"id":"ws-9cf3","org":"tenant-beta"}, {"id":"ws-2b7a","org":"tenant-alpha"}]}
```

kevin: hmm. which code path changed in the refactor? was it the inheritance of project roles or the evaluation short-circuit? PR was rfc/rbac-scope-refactor right?
elaine: yes, that PR moved some checks into evaluatePolicy(), changed default for `scope_enforced` to true but added a fallback that may be mis-evaluating when principal is a service account.

sec-bot: automated-alert: policy-eval anomaly detected 2026-03-20T15:02:11Z — principal svc-ingest match_count=2 tenant_mismatch=true
maria: if service accounts lost their implicit tenant binding, they can reach cross-tenant resources. mitigation: revoke tokens and rotate keys for affected svc accounts now.
rahul: agreed. immediate steps: revoke current token, add temporary deny rule for svc-ingest on list:workspaces, and push a feature-flag to re-enable strict tenant-eval in prod.
kevin: can one of you paste the auth svc stack trace? i want to see where tenant_id is compared.
elaine: stack excerpt:
```
auth.evaluatePolicy(req)
  -> policyEngine.match(principal:something)
  -> checkScope(scope_enforced=true) // line 287
  -> if principal.type == service_account: continue without tenant check // <- suspicious
```

maria: that comment looks like the culprit. service accounts should still be bound to org scope unless explicitly global.
rahul: temporary test to add: assert that for any api path /orgs/{org}/workspaces the policy requires request.tenant == workspace.org. add smoke in CI and a unit in policy-eval.
elaine: I've opened hotfix branch: fix/rbac-tenant-guard. will add guard to deny when principal.tenant != resource.tenant.
oncall-bot: P0 incident created: INC-2026-1437. paging eng-security + eng-platform. sla: 1h followup.
kevin: i'll take the hotfix. ETA 90m to PR, 2h to deploy to staging, run tenant-isolation smoke. if green, roll to prod with canary 5%.
maria: also add a short-lived audit rule to log any cross-tenant reads for the past 24h so we can assess blast radius. query: `audit.events where action=list_workspaces and resource.org != principal.org`.
rahul: good call. also create a script to rotate KMS keys for svc-ingest creds and revoke old KMS unwrap tokens.
elaine: reproduction notes saved to /ops/incident/INC-2026-1437/repro.md and linked in the incident doc. will update as I test the hotfix.
kevin: assigning to me and rahul for the hotfix + rollout. elaine please help with smoke tests.
maria: post-mortem checklist: who approved rfc, why service-account edge-case didn't get a unit test, add regression test to gates.
elaine: timeline update — hotfix branch pushed, unit added, running staging deploy now.
kevin: staging smoke (tenant-isolation) passed. initiating prod canary 5%.
oncall-bot: prod canary started at 2026-03-20T17:14:10Z. monitor dashboards: auth.policy_fail_rate, audit.cross_tenant_reads.
elaine: can confirm cross-tenant reads dropped to zero in canary. if stable for 30m, roll to 100%.
kevin: rolling to 100% now.
rahul: post-incident tasks: 1) revoke affected tokens 2) rotate KMS keys 3) add CI regression 4) update RBAC RFC with explicit service-account tenant binding section.
maria: marking as resolved in incident tracker after followups scheduled.
elaine: thanks all — will draft incident blameless postmortem and link to RFC updates. :thumbsup:
